title: Look Before You Commit: Visual-Evidence-Guided Decoding for Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion multimodal large language models rely on confidence to decide when to commit candidate tokens during generation. In multimodal tasks, however, confidence cannot distinguish whether a candidate originates from image evidence or the language prior. We perform paired forward ablation and find that nearly nine out of ten high-confidence commits are insensitive to the image, while degenerate and hallucination samples exhibit significant increases in the entropy of deep-layer attention organization. Based on this diagnosis, we propose CD-APC, a training-free decoding method. CD-APC performs evidence-adjusted scoring within a base-supported pool and uses dual gating based on model acceptability and contrastive concentration to decide whether to commit, together with an inverse-window mechanism that adapts to inter-step difficulty. translated_title: 三思而后行：面向多模态扩散语言模型的视觉证据引导解码
translated_abstract: 扩散多模态大语言模型依赖置信度来决定在生成过程中何时提交候选词元。然而，在多模态任务中，置信度无法区分候选词元究竟是源自图像证据还是语言先验。我们通过成对前向消融实验发现，近九成的高置信度提交对图像并不敏感，而退化和幻觉样本的深层注意力组织熵呈现出显著增加。基于这一诊断，我们提出了CD-APC，一种无需训练的解码方法。CD-APC在基础支持池内进行证据调整评分，并采用基于模型可接受度与对比集中度的双重门控来决定是否提交词元，同时引入逆窗口机制以自适应不同步骤间的难度。在两个骨干模型和五个基准测试上，CD-APC持续提升了性能，表明……
tldr: 论文发现扩散多模态大模型中近九成高置信度词元提交与图像证据无关，并提出无需训练的视觉证据引导解码方法CD-APC，通过证据调整评分、双重门控与逆窗口机制，在两个骨干模型和五个基准上持续提升性能、抑制幻觉。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that nearly 90% of high-confidence token commits in diffusion multimodal language models are insensitive to image evidence, and proposes CD-APC, a training-free visual-evidence-guided decoding method with evidence-adjusted scoring, dual gating, and an inverse-window mechanism that consistently improves performance across two backbones and five benchmarks while reducing hallucinations.
